definitions.explanation: The tenth sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly December 22 to January 19. Also the constellation Capricornus. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs; often written with the kana やぎ{座|ざ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{山羊座|やぎざ}だ。
{山羊座|やぎざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{努力家|どりょくか}→努力家：22284_doryokuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Capricorn people are said to be hard workers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{山羊座|やぎざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地道|じみち}→地道：15599_jimichi⟧な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}る→実る：00282_minoru⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧だそうだ。
examples.english: This month's horoscope says it's a time when steady effort will pay off for Capricorn.

notes:
The zodiac sign Capricorn, for people born from late December to mid-January. The kana spelling やぎ⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧ is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山羊座|やぎざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person born under Capricorn
- {山羊座|やぎざ}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧: born a Capricorn
- {山羊座|やぎざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: the Capricorn horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments (⟦{星占|ほしうらな}い→星占い：18861_hoshiuranai⟧).
